messages:
pete d: quick follow-up from last night's shard-fallthrough incident. want tidy owners + tiny ETAs so this doesnt recur.
pete d: gist: fallthrough routing + a burst of shard moves caused duplicate alerts to repage across three regions. we paged 3x for the same root cause.

pete d: propose 5 focused actions (small, testable):
  1) migrate dedupe fingerprints off ephemeral `instance` -> stable fingerprint (shard:zone:metric)
  2) add a short repage bloom filter/backoff so identical dedupe_keys don't repage within 10m
  3) create a fallthrough-guard in routing: if rule matches >1 target route, prefer ops-queue until sustained
  4) add a pre-deploy promtool/promlint step to catch instance-based dedupe templates
  5) schedule a 72h noise audit after rollout and post quick metrics at 24/72h
please claim owner + ETA (date or "today EOD").

marisol: i'll own 1 + the linter item (4). plan: replace `instance` with `{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.zone }}:{{ $labels.metric }}` and add CI rule to fail if `instance` used. ETA: Thu EOD (2026-03-27).
denis_k: i'll take 2. idea: implement repage bloom filter in alert-broker that stores dedupe_key + ttl 10m, block repage if seen. will add unit tests + staging flip. ETA: tomorrow AM (2026-03-25).
olya: i'll handle 3 + 5. routing change: prefer route to #ops-queue when a rule would fanout to >1 route; only escalate if sustained_for > 180s. will schedule the 72h monitor and post 24/72h summaries. ETA: Mon AM (2026-03-30).
alert-bot: Incident shard-FALLTHROUGH-2026 acknowledged by pete d. Temporary silence set by olya for #pager-duty until 2026-03-25T08:00Z.

denis_k: sketch of bloom-filter idea for review:
```yaml
# broker-side pseudocode
if bloom.contains(dedupe_key):
  suppress_repage()
else:
  bloom.add(dedupe_key, ttl=10m)
  emit_pager()
```

marisol: dedupe template i'll use:
```yaml
labels:
  dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.zone }}:{{ $labels.metric }}"
```
will include migration doc and grep script in the PR.

olya: routing snippet for feedback:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: rule.targets > 1
    action: route_to_ops_queue
    escalate_if: sustained_for > 180s
```

pete d: can each owner drop a one-line ETA so i can populate the PM tracker? i'll schedule a 15m check-in next Thu to close the loop.
marisol: ETA Thu EOD (2026-03-27) - PR + CI linter.
denis_k: ETA 2026-03-25 AM - broker patch + tests.
olya: ETA 2026-03-30 AM - routing PR + monitor schedule.

pete d: after deploy we'll run a quick staging replay: `./tools/alert-sim --fixture shard-fallthrough.json --repeat 600` please run locally and paste results here.
denis_k: will run the replay in staging and post 24h results.
marisol: i'll run the grep migration and open follow-up tickets for any alerts that fail lint.
olya: i'll aggregate the 24/72h noise reports and create follow-ups if top-10 noisy rules dont fall by >50%.

pete d: blockers?
marisol: none.
denis_k: infra ok for staging, no blockers.
olya: ops will watch the first 2 hours post-flip. no blockers.

pete d: thanks all. i'll update PM tracker with owners/ETAs and close this thread after the 72h report. re-open if anything slips. :thumbsup:
